paras: Turnaround: you get a version from a photo or a link, while a filming day waits on a person, a place, and a date.

sections.h2: How to Keep a Small Test Fair
paras: Change only one thing between versions, so the result points at that one thing.
Worth testing, one at a time: the opening, the setting, the shape, the length, and the line you add afterward. Start with the opening. It decides whether anyone sees the rest.

sections.h2: How the Versions Should Run Together
paras: One campaign gives every version the same audience, the same budget, and the same product page.
Many ad accounts let several ads share one group. Some also split the audience across versions. A version that barely ran has not been tested. Leave the ads alone while the test is live.
sections.alt: Two pairs of hands hold the same plain white cream jar in side-by-side poses.

sections.h2: How to Tell Which Version Works
paras: Wait until each version has actually played before you name a winner.

Read three numbers in order. First, how many people stay past the opening. Second, how often people click. Third, the cost each time someone buys. A version can get more views and still lose on sales.
sections.alt: A hand rests beside a plain white cream jar and a blank white card.

sections.h2: What the Next Test Should Change
paras: Keep the version that brings sales at a cost you can accept. Turn off the clear losers, and change one new thing.
Write down the date, what changed, and the result. When a winner starts costing more per sale, make fresh versions. Work through the opening, the setting, the shape, the length, then the offer.

faq.q: What does the AI video ads generator do?
faq.a: A tool that makes a short video ad from a product, a prompt, or a link, with a script, a presenter, and a voice. You do not film, and you do not need an edit bay.

faq.q: How do I create a video ad to test?
faq.a: Upload a photo or paste the product link, and name the opening you want. Download the shape this test uses.

faq.q: What should I look for when I pick a tool for ad tests?
faq.a: Pick a tool that can make a second opening of the same product from the photo you already have, with no new shoot.

faq.q: Do I pay to make each version?
faq.a: Yes. A clip is 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, or 120 for 30. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600.

faq.q: Can I run the file as a paid ad?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no watermark. It can run as a paid placement and sit on the product page.

faq.q: Which frames can I download, and where can they run?
faq.a: Use 9:16 on a phone screen, 1:1 in a feed, and 16:9 when the screen is wide. 4:3 and 3:4 are for a placement that lists them. A second shape is a different test.

faq.q: Can I test ads for more than one product?
faq.a: Yes, if each product has its own photo. Reuse one opening as the note. Many products still means one file each.

faq.q: Should I stop filming with people I hire?
faq.a: No. Keep a filmed spot when you want a person you hired on camera. Use a generated file when you are still choosing the first second.

faq.q: Can a generated ad be turned down by the ad account?
faq.a: It can, for the same reasons any ad can. If the line sounds like a customer wrote a review, say so the way that app currently asks. Read the rules before you raise the budget.

faq.q: How many versions should a small shop run?
faq.a: Start with a few, often three. More than that splits a small budget so far that no version gets a fair chance to play.
The opening. It decides whether anyone watches the rest. Keep the product, the length, and the shape the same until that result is clear.

faq.q: Can I change the price on only one version?
faq.a: No. While you are testing the video or the photo, put the same words, the same price, and the same music on every file. Test the offer in a later round, on its own.

faq.q: Where do the numbers come from?
faq.a: From the ad account, after each version has played. The test does not invent a winner. You read who stayed, who clicked, and what a sale cost.

faq.q: What if the ad account barely shows one version?
faq.a: That version was not tested. Wait until each file has had a real chance to play, or the comparison is noise.

faq.q: Do I have to say the presenter is generated?
faq.a: Yes, when the ad could be read as a real customer's review. Follow that platform's disclosure rule.
